name: jira_watchers_add
description: Adds a user as a watcher of an issue (POST /rest/api/3/issue/{issueIdOrKey}/watchers)

issue_key.description: The ID or key of the issue to watch, for example DESK-8.

watcher_name.description: The display name of the user to add as a watcher, for example Tom Alvarez.

watcher_email.description: The email address of the user to add as a watcher.
